title: Declare the minimum supported engine version in the client
summary: The client records, in one place, the minimum engine version it supports and exposes it together with its own version in a stable machine-readable form that the installer and the startup check both read, so the requirement is declared once instead of being implied. Producing this version information works with no engine installed.
plan_goal: Make Forgel and Forgel Code install and run as one working pair: give the engine `forgel` its own installer, add a mode of the Forgel Code installer that installs both binaries together (offered by default in the README, idempotent — when the engine is already present it compares versions and installs only a strictly newer one), and introduce a declared minimum supported engine version for Forgel Code, checked at startup, so a missing or too-old engine produces a clear actionable message instead of `engine forgel: executable not found: forgel`.
